summary: FE Bug: Part Sales -> Parts -> Margin column after it is edited it shows wrong sell price.
reported_issue: On Part Sales, after requesting a Special Order part and changing the Margin value, the automatically calculated Sell Price was wrong.
expected_after_fix: Editing the Margin on a Part Sale part recalculates the Sell Price correctly (sell = cost / (1 - margin/100)).
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened Part Sale P9-1051 Parts tab (/workorders/<psid>/part-requests).
Selected a part line with a real cost (cost=10.00, original margin=54, sell=21.74).
Edited the Margin input to 40 and blurred (Tab).
Read back the recalculated Sell Price and checked it against the expected formula.
actual_now: After setting Margin=40 on a part with cost=10.00, the Sell Price recalculated to 16.67. Expected = 10.00/(1-0.40) = 16.67. Implied margin from the resulting sell price = 40.01%. Calculation is correct.
notes: Part Sales Margin->Sell Price recalculation is accurate on current staging; the wrong-sell-price behavior does not reproduce. Part Sales share the WO part-requests UI.
